_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 33.98x; +79% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.81; conservative 2yr -20%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.6%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.0%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2020-01-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 33.98x (74.7% downside to Bear $70 / +2.2% upside to Bull $283) | Adj composite 2.54 vs market 3.35: gap -0.81 [OVERVALUED] | +79% above the EPP floor $155 (18x FY19E $8.61) | Conservative 2-yr case: -19.9% total (-9.9%/yr) | At 32.2x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $366 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +10.5% in Q3 2019, forward revenues +9.2% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2019 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
